slot_scores.name: robot_doll_mutual_exclusion
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never specifically asked whether producing robots excludes doll production; its only related question was a vague catch-all for 'any other requirements,' and the robot/doll exclusivity was volunteered by the user simulator.

slot_scores.name: doll_model_car_quantity_limit
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Regarding the constraint that the number of dolls manufactured cannot exceed the number of model cars manufactured, does this apply even if no model cars are produced (meaning dolls would also be zero), or is this constraint only active when model cars are being produced?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the doll-to-model-car quantity relationship and clarified the boundary condition when no model cars are produced.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL after resolving H2 but without ever specifically asking about the robot/doll mutual exclusion, leaving H1 as an unresolved P1 hidden slot.

summary: The agent clarified the doll/model-car quantity relationship well but missed the robot/doll mutual exclusion, relying on a vague catch-all that let the user simulator volunteer the constraint.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
